title: Perf events and tool security
versionOrDate: Current Linux kernel administration guide; reviewed 2026-08-02
relevance: Primary Linux kernel guidance for what perf_events can expose, how credentials, CAP_PERFMON and perf_event_paranoid constrain collection, and which file-descriptor and memory limits affect a session. It supports least-privilege profiling and the rule that captured samples describe only the selected event, scope, workload and interval.
